General Motors EV1 VIN #4G5PX2250V0200212 was never supposed to survive. Like most EV1s leased to drivers in the late 1990s, this adorably green electric icon was originally going to be crushed and turned to scrap metal, never to be seen again.
Except that’s not what happened. According to the original lessee from ’97, whom I spoke with on the phone, a series of legal twists and turns meant this EV1 was saved from the crusher by GM. Instead, the car ended up forgotten in a tow pound in Atlanta. Earlier this week, VIN #212 became the first EV1
to ever be legally sold to the public
.
The new owner has big plans. He told me over the phone that he and a team of like-minded individuals have already begun the process to restore this EV1 to its former glory.
The EV1 Story In a Nutshell
Electric cars are a mainstay of today’s automotive landscape, but back in the 1990s, they were barely a blip on anyone’s radar. The EV1 was the first mass-produced electric car to be offered to the public, but it was only available in Southern states like California and Arizona, as cold weather would’ve zapped the lead-acid battery packs’ range, which was rated at around 90 miles.
With just 137 horsepower spinning the single front motor, the EV1 isn’t very impressive by modern standards. But it set the stage for future EVs to come, and brought with it a host of other innovations, like regenerative braking and low rolling-resistance tires. The two-door teardrop design was a huge factor in squeezing the most out of those batteries; the EV1 remains one of the slipperiest cars to ever hit the market, with a drag coefficient of just 0.19. That’s better than any of today’s Lucids or Teslas.
ADVERTISEMENT
As I mentioned earlier, GM never actually sold any EV1s to the public. They were leased, with most of them taken back by the factory and crushed due to slowing demand and high costs,
according to a former engineer
. According to a nifty
tracking page
put together by
Hemmings
, GM saved around 40 examples and donated them to museums and universities. The subject in this story is not one of those cars, but a previously unknown, hidden example that the internet had never seen before.
“Is That My Car?”
An in-period photo of VIN #212, provided by Sawyer to The Autopian.
Those were among the first words uttered to me over the phone by Jonathan Sawyer, a Boulder, Colorado-based electrical engineer who was the original lessee of VIN #212 back in 1997.
Sawyer is a lifelong electric car enthusiast, having owned several obscure and interesting EVs over the years.
“I’ve always had electric cars,” he told me over the phone. “I’ve got electric cars you wouldn’t believe. I’ve got the first [Tesla] Roadster here in Colorado, and Elon Musk personally gave me the key.
I have the electric RAV4, the
original one
. I convinced Toyota to lease them in Colorado, and I got a lease, and four years ago, they tried to take it away from me, and I sued them, and I won, and they gave me the car.”
Sawyer was understandably excited to get his hands on the world’s first mass-market, production EV. But living in Colorado, GM wouldn’t lease him a car. So he got clever.
ADVERTISEMENT
“My sister lived in Tucson, so I got my sister to lease the car,” Sawyer said. “And then I smuggled the car up to Colorado, which pissed the shit out of them.”
GM allowed Sawyer to hold onto his lease, but he kept having to send the car back to Arizona for repairs. “Because the batteries were terrible, I would always ship the car back to Tempe, Arizona,” he told me.
The T-shaped battery pack. Source: GM
According to Sawyer, GM issued a recall to fix a faulty charger that had the possibility of causing a fire. But instead of fixing the cars, they simply took them and never gave them back to the owners.
“They knew I was the one guy that wasn’t going to turn my car in, and they waited for me because every five months, I would have to send my car back to the dealership, because they always had to replace the battery,” Sawyer told me. “Those lead-acid batteries are terrible. I have a lease on the car.'”
Sawyer immediately filed a lawsuit against the company, but he didn’t want to sit around while his car was locked up at the dealer.

  - [madamelic] 分享了个人经历，描述学校意外发现并修复了一辆被遗忘的GM EV1，认为这是难得一见的历史文物。  
  - [robin_reala] 提出争议，指出20世纪初已有约3万辆电动车，质疑EV1是否为“首款量产电动车”。

• **电动车被销毁的原因**  
  - [throw0101c] 引用纪录片《谁杀死了电动车？》，认为EV1的消亡涉及汽车制造商、石油行业和政府等多方利益。  
  - [api] 补充认为EV1因传统车企对燃油技术的沉没成本而被扼杀，并赞扬特斯拉推动了电动车普及。

• **法律与所有权争议**  
  - [potato3732842] 讨论车辆所有权的法律漏洞，指出EV1因无法登记为“被盗车辆”而长期处于法律灰色地带。  
  - [rvba] 质疑执法漏洞：若跨州盗窃车辆后FBI不介入，是否变相纵容犯罪？

• **技术复刻与版权问题**  
  - [Theodores] 提出是否能用现代电池复刻EV1，但担忧GM的版权限制。  
  - [api] 对比现代电动车（如日产Leaf）的技术进步，认为EV1的电池技术虽落后，但设计理念超前。

补充讨论：
- 幽默与调侃：[adenta] 玩笑称“是否人人有个藏有EV1的朋友”，[hank808] 调侃文中“加州是南方州”的地理错误。  
- 争议焦点：EV1的历史地位（是否为首款量产电动车）、销毁背后的利益动机、跨州盗窃的法律执行问题。

data.title: Building the largest known Kubernetes cluster
data.author: TangerineDream
data.article_summary: 谷歌云宣布在实验模式下成功运行了包含13万个节点的Kubernetes集群，是当前官方支持规模的两倍。这一突破不仅涉及节点数量的扩展，还包括Pod创建、调度吞吐等关键维度的优化，实现了每秒1000个Pod的吞吐量。谷歌指出，AI工作负载正推动对超大规模集群的需求，未来可能稳定在10万节点规模。为此，谷歌开发了多项架构创新，包括优化API服务器读取扩展性和分布式存储后端，这些改进既支持超大规模集群，也提升了中小规模集群的性能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Google 实现 130K 节点 Kubernetes 集群的技术挑战和实际应用价值

不同观点：
• **质疑性能与现有技术的对比**  
  - hazz99 认为 QPS 数字并不突出，横向对比 PostgreSQL 和 Vitess 等已有技术可能表现更好，质疑 Kubernetes 控制平面的性能瓶颈。  
  - moralestapia 提到非 K8s 环境下可实现更高吞吐（~200 万 QPS），暗示 K8s 可能带来性能负担。  

• **对技术实现和生态影响的担忧**  
  - __turbobrew__ 指出依赖 Spanner 的“秘密武器”无法普惠社区，etcd 仍是上游 K8s 的瓶颈，且缺乏替代方案的动力。  
  - xyse53 提到 GCS fuse 的稳定性和性能问题，认为其实用性有限。  

• **架构合理性与实际需求争议**  
  - zkmon 和 jakupovic 质疑超大规模单集群的必要性，主张多小型集群更优（如 jakupovic 的 <100 节点实践）。  
  - rvz 强调除非是谷歌级别的公司，否则追求 130K 节点是架构和成本上的过度设计，批评“未盈利先扩展”的风气。  

• **替代方案与优化建议**  
  - Nextgrid 认为在云虚拟机场景下，K8s 可能冗余，直接使用大规格 VM 更高效。  
  - yanhangyhy 引用 1M 节点文档，暗示标题可能存在误导。  

补充讨论：  
- **行业案例对比**：sandGorgon 提及 OpenAI 2021 年的 7500 节点集群，引发对实际超大规模用例的讨论。  
- **技术愿景冲突**：blamestross 从分布式系统角度，认为集中式管理限制了规模潜力。  
- **内容批判**：jeffbee 反对技术文章中强行加入 AI 营销词汇，主张纯粹的技术讨论。  

争议焦点：  
1. **单集群超大规模是否值得**：支持者强调技术突破（如 Google），反对者认为多集群更实际。  
2. **K8s 的性能瓶颈**：etcd、控制平面效率与替代方案成为关键分歧。  
3. **需求合理性**：rvz 等认为非巨头公司无需此类规模，与实验性探索形成对立。

Containers & Kubernetes
How Google Does It: Building the largest known Kubernetes cluster, with 130,000 nodes
November 21, 2025
Besher Massri
Software Engineer
Maciek Różacki
Group Product Manager

At Google Cloud, we’re constantly pushing the scalability of
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
so that it can keep up with increasingly demanding workloads — especially AI. GKE already
supports massive
65,000-node clusters
, and at KubeCon, we shared that we successfully ran a
130,000-node cluster in experimental mode
— twice the number of nodes compared to the officially supported and tested limit.
This kind of scaling isn't just about increasing the sheer number of nodes; it also requires scaling other critical dimensions, such as
Pod creation
and
scheduling throughput
. For instance, during this test, we sustained Pod throughput of
1,000 Pods per second
, as well as storing over
1 million objects
in our optimized distributed storage. In this blog, we take a look at the trends driving demand for these kinds of mega-clusters, and do a deep dive on the architectural innovations we implemented to make this extreme scalability a reality.
The rise of the mega cluster
Our largest customers are actively pushing the boundaries of GKE’s scalability and performance with their AI workloads. In fact, we already have numerous customers operating clusters in the 20-65K node range, and we anticipate the demand for large clusters to stabilize around the 100K node mark.
This sets up an interesting dynamic. In short, we are transitioning from a world constrained by chip supply to a world constrained by electrical power. Consider the fact that a single NVIDIA GB200 GPU needs 2700W of power. With tens of thousands, or even more, of these chips, a single cluster's power footprint could easily scale to hundreds of megawatts — ideally distributed across multiple data centers. Thus, for AI platforms exceeding 100K nodes, we’ll need robust multi-cluster solutions that can orchestrate distributed training or reinforcement learning across clusters and data centers. This is a significant challenge, and we’re actively investing in tools like
MultiKueue
to address it, with further innovations on the horizon. We are also advancing high-performance RDMA networking with the recently announced
managed DRANET
, improving topology awareness to maximize performance for massive AI workloads. Stay tuned.
At the same time, these investments also benefit users who operate at more modest scales — the vast majority of GKE customers. By hardening GKE's core systems for extreme usage, we create substantial headroom for average clusters, making them more resilient to errors, increasing tolerance for user misuse of the Kubernetes API, and generally optimizing all controllers for faster performance. And of course, all GKE customers, large and small, benefit from investments in an intuitive, self-service experience.
Key architectural innovations
With that said, achieving this level of scale requires significant innovations throughout the Kubernetes ecosystem, including control plane, custom scheduling and storage. Let’s take a look at a few key areas that were critical to this project.
Optimized read scalability
When operating at scale, there’s a need for a strongly consistent and snapshottable API server watch cache. At 130,000 nodes, the sheer volume of read requests to the API server can overwhelm the central object datastore. To solve this, Kubernetes includes several complementary features to offload these read requests from the central object datastore.
First, the Consistent Reads from Cache feature (KEP-2340), detailed in
here
, enables the API server to serve strongly consistent data directly from its in-memory cache. This drastically reduces the load on the object storage database for common read patterns such as filtered list requests (e.g., "all Pods on a specific node"), by ensuring the cache's data is verifiably up-to-date before it serves the request.
Building on this foundation, the Snapshottable API Server Cache feature (KEP-4988) further enhances performance by allowing the API server to serve LIST requests for previous states (via pagination or by specifying
resourceVersion
) directly from that same consistent watch cache. By generating a B-tree "snapshot" of the cache at a specific resource version, the API server can efficiently handle subsequent LIST requests without repeatedly querying the datastore.
Together, these two enhancements address the problem of read amplification, ensuring the API server remains fast and responsive by serving both strongly consistent filtered reads and list requests of previous states directly from memory. This is essential for maintaining cluster-wide component health at extreme scale.
An optimized distributed storage backend

data.author: Brajeshwar
data.article_summary: 中国二氧化碳排放量连续18个月持平或下降。2025年第三季度数据显示，电动汽车的快速普及使交通燃料排放减少5%，水泥和钢铁生产排放也有所下降。尽管电力需求增长加快，但电力行业排放持平，这得益于太阳能和风能发电的大幅增长。2025年前三季度，中国新增240吉瓦太阳能和61吉瓦风能装机容量，创可再生能源新纪录。不过，化工行业排放增长10%，抵消了其他领域的减排成果。

China’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions were unchanged from a year earlier in the third quarter of 2025, extending a flat or

in March 2024.
The rapid adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) saw CO2 emissions from transport fuel drop by 5% year-on-year, while there were also declines from cement and steel production.
The new analysis for Carbon Brief shows that while emissions from the power sector were flat year-on-year, a big rise in the chemical industry’s CO2 output offset reductions elsewhere.

Power-sector CO2 emissions were flat in the third quarter, even as electricity demand growth accelerated to 6.1%, from 3.7% in the first half of the year.
This was achieved thanks to electricity generation from solar growing by 46% and wind by 11% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2025.
In the first nine months of the year, China completed 240 gigawatts (GW) of solar and 61GW of wind capacity, putting it on track for a new renewable record in 2025.
Oil demand and emissions in the transport sector fell by 5% in the third quarter, but grew elsewhere by 10%, as the production of plastics and other chemicals surged.

data.title: Typing an AI prompt is not 'active' music creation
data.author: JeanKage
data.article_summary: 文章批评了AI音乐初创公司Suno的CEO将输入文本提示生成音乐称为"真正主动"创作的说法。作者认为这种做法贬低了音乐创作的价值，指出AI生成的音乐缺乏灵魂，且公司每月24美元的高级订阅方案并不比传统数字音频工作站更便宜易用。尽管Suno的技术令人印象深刻，但作者强调真正的音乐创作需要更多主动参与，而非简单地输入提示。文章反映了艺术家群体对AI音乐的普遍抵触情绪。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[AI生成音乐的艺术价值、创作参与度及伦理影响]

不同观点：
• **AI生成音乐的辅助价值**  
  TrackerFF认为AI（如Suno）在音乐制作中可作为高效工具，尤其对独立音乐人而言，能简化鼓点编程等繁琐环节，提升成品质量。但他强调自己仍是创作主导者，且对AI生成的成果缺乏“音乐成就感”，类比使用样本包。  
  **争议点**：AI是否仅是一种高级工具，还是削弱了创作本质？

• **AI音乐的平庸性与同质化**  
  TrackerFF指出纯AI生成的音乐虽技术精湛，但缺乏独特性，仅是训练数据的“平均值”，并以现代乡村音乐为例批评其原本就像“人类制作的AI糟粕”。  
  **论据**：AI可能加速音乐风格的趋同化。

• **AI创作的伦理争议**  
  TrackerFF和Rodeoclash（引用The Oatmeal漫画）隐含对AI艺术伦理的担忧，如训练数据来源、人类创作被边缘化的问题。  

• **讽刺性质疑创作参与度**  
  vrighter以反讽口吻调侃“反复按Enter键”算作“主动参与”，质疑仅通过调整提示词是否构成真正的创作。geldedus的挑衅式回应（要求展示AI音乐成果）同样反映对AI创作真实性的怀疑。  

补充讨论：
• **历史类比**：Kim_Bruning提及合成器与采样的争议，暗示AI可能像过去的新技术一样，经历从排斥到接纳的过程。  
• **实践案例**：TrackerFF提供了具体工作流（录制草稿→AI优化），为讨论AI在创作链中的角色提供了实例。

Terrence O'Brien
is the Verge’s weekend editor. He has over 18 years of experience, including 10 years as managing editor at Engadget.
Suno, the AI music startup being
sued
by the big three
major labels
, the
RIAA
, and even some
indie acts
for illegally training its model on copyrighted material, just raised $250 million (which might help pay its legal bills). What caught my eye in the
Wall Street Journal
article about the funding round and the company’s insane $2.45 billion valuation, however, was Suno co-founder and Chief Executive Mikey Shulman being quoted as saying:
“There is a really big future for music where way more people are doing it in a really active way, and where it has a much more valuable place in society.”
Suno is primarily known for its text-prompt-based, push-button Create feature, which generates entire tracks using an AI model. (
I tried it
— it’s technically impressive, but has all the soul of a PowerPoint presentation.) Which leaves me wondering, what exactly is Mikey Shulman’s definition of “really active,” and in what way does the creation of more
AI-generated music
increase music’s value in society? I’ve reached out to Suno to see if Shulman had any context or additional comments that might help clarify this statement, but I haven’t received a response.
Related
Suno’s upgraded AI music generator is technically impressive, but still soulless
Purely AI-generated art can’t get copyright protection, says Copyright Office
As a musician myself, I find the idea that asking an AI for a “live band, jazz rap track with Rhodes piano, a trumpet solo and gravely vocals at 96BPM” would be considered “really active” downright insulting. And I know I’m not alone. Countless other
artists
and
critics
have been
very clear
that they see
AI music
as an
abomination
that they’ve even tried to
sabotage
.
But in the interest of fairness, maybe Shulman is talking about the company’s recently launched
Studio
offering, which is closer to a traditional digital audio workstation (DAW).
Even still, Suno Studio is focused on generative music creation. It can perform audio transformations, so you can hum a melody and turn it into a trumpet, and record live audio to lay down a guitar solo. But it can also generate drum and vocal tracks completely from its AI model. In fact, it seems
primarily designed
for deep dive editing and stem separation of songs you’ve already created using Suno’s prompt-based Create. And while chopping up AI-created tracks to fine-tune a song is certainly more involved than simply pressing a button and accepting whatever
Suno v5
spits out, I wouldn’t call it “really active.”
So maybe Shulman simply means that Suno Studio is accomplishing the company’s stated goal of bringing “interactive music tools to the average person.” Well, to gain access to Suno Studio, you need to shell out for a Premier plan, which starts at $24 a month, or $288 a year. FL Studio starts at $99 and includes a lifetime of free updates. Ableton Live Lite is included free with many budget MIDI controllers. And GarageBand comes pre-installed on every Mac. So Suno isn’t cheaper than the big players in the music production space. And, while Suno Studio is certainly more stripped down than those DAWs, frankly, most people could figure out the basics in any of them in just a couple of hours.
Related
The music industry is all in on

data.title: Fast Lua runtime written in Rust
data.author: akagusu
data.article_summary: Astra是一个基于Rust构建的高性能Lua运行时环境，主打极速运行和容错能力。它具有以下特点：1) 采用Rust零成本抽象和异步多线程运行时实现超高性能；2) 完美集成Lua脚本；3) 模块化可扩展架构；4) 开箱即用的单二进制文件。示例代码展示了如何快速创建HTTP服务器、注册路由、处理请求和返回响应，支持JSON返回和状态码设置等常见功能。Astra既可作为独立Lua运行时，也能轻松构建高性能服务器应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Astra项目是否是一个真正的用Rust编写的Lua引擎]

不同观点：
• Astra并非真正的Rust实现的Lua引擎，而是一个基于现有C/C++实现的Lua封装。真正的Rust实现Lua引擎是piccolo（由csnover指出）
• Astra作者ElhamAryanpur承认项目描述不够清晰，并解释项目初衷是为了加速开发，将现有的Rust库与Lua绑定打包成单一二进制文件
• 多位评论者（mwkaufma、forgotpwd16、coderedart）批评项目命名和描述具有误导性，尤其是"runtime"一词的使用不当

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：项目命名和描述的准确性，特别是"runtime"和"written in Rust"的表述
• 性能问题：joshlk质疑项目声称的"Incredibly Fast"但缺乏性能基准
• 替代方案讨论：用户推荐了其他类似项目如Luvit、Lune、Zune等（coderedart、james2doyle）
• 技术实现细节：VWWHFSfQ指出项目可能使用了mlua Rust绑定而非从头实现
• 命名冲突：pjmlp提到与Wordpress插件Astra的命名冲突问题
• 比较请求：johnisgood询问与LuaJIT的性能比较

data.title: Serflings is a remake of The Settlers 1
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: 《Serflings》是一款对经典游戏《The Settlers 1》（或《Serf City》）的忠实复刻版本，保留了原版核心玩法并增加了高清分辨率、局域网对战等新功能。运行游戏需从原版复制特定文件（如SPAE.PA），支持DOS版和历史版的游戏文件。提供稳定版和开发版下载，需Java 17环境或集成运行时的版本。复刻版兼容原版存档，操作与原版一致，新增快捷键调整游戏速度、缩放等功能。支持多语言，包含原版所有任务和AI，但部分原版功能（如建筑替换）尚未实现。游戏可通过Ubisoft购买原版。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[对《The Settlers》系列游戏的怀旧与现代延续的讨论]

不同观点：
• 对《The Settlers 1》和《The Settlers 2》的怀旧情感：
  - [YoukaiCountry] 和 [oersted] 表达了对早期游戏的喜爱，特别是第二代的复杂物流系统和节点网格设计。
  - [peepee1982] 提到第一代的简单性是其魅力所在。

• 现代延续游戏的推荐：
  - [slightwinder] 推荐了《Pioneers of Pagonia》，认为它是对最新官方《Settlers》游戏失败的回应，旨在服务老粉丝。
  - [jamesu] 推荐了《The Colonists》作为现代3D替代品。

• 开源克隆游戏的提及：
  - [YoukaiCountry] 和 [saubeidl] 都提到了《Widelands》，一个开源的《Settlers II》克隆，带有额外功能。

补充讨论：
• 游戏机制的现实应用：
  - [verytrivial] 幽默地提到将《Settlers》的资源移动算法应用于日常生活中。

• 法律与道德问题：
  - [falcor84] 提出了关于逆向工程和AI生成艺术以替代原始游戏文件的合法性问题。

争议焦点：
• [falcor84] 的评论引发了关于使用AI或人类重新创作游戏内容以规避版权问题的讨论，这是一个未解决的争议点。

Serflings is a remake of The Settlers 1 or Serf City in some countries.
The game is as close to the original game as possible but also includes some useful extensions like higher resolutions and network
games.
Important: To get the game to start you need one file from the original settlers 1 game because graphics and sounds are read from
there. Please copy the file SPAE.PA (or SPAD.PA for German, SPAF.PA for French) in the same directory of Serflings. If the
History Edition has been installed in the default path, the copy is not necessary.
The following paths will be searched for game files in the given order:
1. Current directory; usually the place of the exe or jar file
2. Sub directory data
3. (Windows only) Default path of the History Edition: C:\Program Files (x86)\Ubisoft\Ubisoft Game Launcher\games\thesettlers\loca
The remake is compatible with both the files from the DOS version and the History Edition.
The original game as History Edition is sold by Ubisoft either as part of the History Collection or individually.

https://store.ubi.com/uk/the-settlers-history-collection/5b647011ef3aa548048c5977.html

The remake supports the loading of saved games from the original game. For this to work you have to copy the file for the archive
(ARCHIV.DS) and the files with the actual saved games (SAVE0.DS, SAVE1.DS, ...) to the folder of the remake.
The controls match the ones from the original game including special click (right + left mouse buttons together) for actions like
viewing the content of a building and scrolling by holding the right mouse button.
You may use the following additional keys:
1 - 5: Buttons in south panel
Space: Building help
Arrow keys: Scrolling
Mouse wheel: Zoom
TAB: Open the next new message
ESC: Close a window in game
p: Pause
+ and -: Adjust game speed
0: Reset game speed to default
v: Toggle video mode VGA/SVGA
F11 or Alt+Enter: Toggle fullscreen
s: Toggle sound
m: Toggle music
F3: Toggle display of debug information
You may pass the following command line arguments to the game:
--enable-preview: Activates preview mode for new functions which are still in development (see changelog)
--validate-data: Executes a simple check for the original game data
--system-info: Displays internal information about the environment of Java and the identified hardware
Features already included
Most of the features from the original game (see below for missing features):
All trainings
All missions including passwords and ending animation
Custom games as singleplayer
Fully functional AI as present in the original game
Saving and loading of games, including full support of savegames from the original game
All main functions of the original game
All map functions
All menus for statistics and settings
Supported languages: German, English, French, Polish
Arbitrarily high resolutions
Smooth scrolling
Zoom
Automatic pathfinding on path construction including a preview function
Network games over LAN (1 vs 1) including team games
Indication of the work radius for buildings
Optional control without special click (middle click)
Changing game speed
The state of completed missions will be saved
Display of mission and game goals
Representation of different types of food in mines
Additional information about transport in window for castle or stock
Still missing or planned features
Original game: Replacing an existing building by a new one
Original game: Timers for menus or buildings

data.author: blaiz2025
data.article_summary: Cynthia是一款功能强大的MIDI音乐播放软件，支持播放.mid、.midi和.rmi格式文件，提供文件夹播放和播放列表（.m3u）两种播放模式。主要特点包括：实时调整播放速度（10%-1000%）、音量控制（最高200%）、进度条跳转、歌词显示、多轨/声道管理、钢琴键盘可视化等。支持Xbox手柄控制，可连接多个MIDI设备并同步调整。软件内置25首示例MIDI，提供便携版和开源代码（Delphi/Lazarus），兼容Windows及Wine环境。界面可自定义颜色和布局，适合不同屏幕尺寸。

data.title: Show HN: Virtual SLURM HPC cluster in a Docker Compose
data.author: ciclotrone
data.article_summary:
这篇文章介绍了exactlab开源的虚拟高性能计算（HPC）集群项目vhpc，主要特点包括：

1. 基于Docker容器技术，使用SLURM工作负载管理器和Rocky Linux 9系统
2. 支持OpenMPI并行计算（节点内和节点间）
3. 提供完整的用户管理和作业统计功能（可选MariaDB）
4. 包含快速启动配置：1个登录节点和2个工作节点（各4vCPU/2GB内存）
5. 支持SSH密钥和密码两种认证方式访问集群
6. 提供SLURM和MPI作业提交示例命令

该项目适合用于HPC环境测试和教育目的，由专业HPC咨询公司eXact lab开发并采用MIT许可开源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[关于现代HPC集群部署工具的讨论，特别是Slurm-docker-cluster与其他HPC管理工具的比较]

不同观点：
• [支持Slurm-docker-cluster的观点]
  - 用户zaheenadeep分享了自己的项目slurm-docker-cluster，表明这是一种可行的HPC集群部署方法。
  - 用户robot-wrangler赞赏这种现代且整洁的仓库，认为其比陈旧的Ansible/Chef/Puppet脚本更实用。

• [其他HPC管理工具的观点]
  - 用户throw0101c列举了多种云HPC管理工具，如AWS ParallelCluster、Google Cluster Toolkit等，提供了更广泛的解决方案。
  - 用户ZeroCool2u提到OpenOnDemand，询问其与Slurm-docker-cluster的比较，关注点在于是否适用于大规模生产环境。

• [对SLURM替代品的期望]
  - 用户IshKebab表达了对SLURM现代替代品的期望，但认为这种希望渺茫，因为其公司仍在使用SGE。

争议焦点：
• Slurm-docker-cluster是否适用于大规模生产环境，以及其与其他HPC管理工具（如OpenOnDemand）的比较。

vHPC: a Virtual HPC Cluster with SLURM and MPI
A Docker-based virtualization of a High Performance Computing (HPC) system
running SLURM workload manager with OpenMPI support and optional full job
accounting on Rocky Linux 9. This project creates a lean, production-ready
multi-container environment.
About eXact lab
This project is open-sourced by
eXact lab S.r.l.
, a
consultancy specializing in scientific and high-performance computing
solutions. We help organizations optimize their computational workflows,
implement scalable HPC infrastructure, and accelerate scientific research
through tailored technology solutions.
Need HPC expertise?
Contact us
for consulting
services in scientific computing, cluster optimization, and performance
engineering.
Index
Key Features
Usage
Quick start
Accessing the Cluster
Example SLURM Commands
Working with Shared Storage
Configuration
(Optional) Install Extra Packages
(Optional) Custom SLURM Configuration
Adding More Workers
Building the images
Technical Details
Architecture
Volumes
MPI
Security Considerations
Software Versions
Troubleshooting
License
Key Features
MPI Ready
: Full OpenMPI support with intra-node and inter-node job
execution
User Management
: User synchronization from head node to workers via
mounted home volume
Shared Configuration
: All SLURM configs shared via mounted volume
Full Job Accounting (Optional)
: Complete
sacct
functionality with
MariaDB backend. You can opt not to start the database container and the
system will still work, just without accounting
Runtime customisation
: Install additional software onto the cluster at
container startup without the need to rebuild the image, see
Install Extra
Packages
below
Usage
Quick start
Simply
docker compose up -d
The virtual cluster will start up in its default configuration:
One login node
Two worker nodes
with 4 vCPU each and 2048M of vRAM
Full accounting
via a database node (MariaDB)
Accessing the Cluster
Although it is of course possible to use
docker exec
to access the
containers, we provide SSH access to emulate common cluster setups.
SSH Key Authentication (Recommended)
:
Upon container startup, you'll see a directory
ssh-keys/
appearing. Those
keys are enabled for both the root and non-privileged user.
You can reach the different nodes via
Head Node
:
ssh -i ./ssh-keys/id_ed25519 -p 2222 root@localhost
Worker1
:
ssh -i ./ssh-keys/id_ed25519 -p 2223 root@localhost
Worker2
:
ssh -i ./ssh-keys/id_ed25519 -p 2224 root@localhost
Swap
root
with
user
to access as non privileged user.
Warning
: Each image version generates its own SSH keys. When upgrading to a
new image version, remove the old keys with
rm -r ssh-keys/
before starting
the new infrastructure to avoid authentication failures.
Note for SSH Agent Users
: If you have multiple keys loaded in your SSH
agent, SSH may exhaust the server's allowed authentication attempts before
trying the specified key file. If you encounter "Too many authentication
failures", use the
-o IdentitiesOnly=yes
option to bypass agent keys:
ssh -i ./ssh-keys/id_ed25519 -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -p 2222 root@localhost
Password Authentication (Fallback)
:
Head Node SSH
:
ssh -p 2222 root@localhost
(password:
rootpass
)
Worker1 SSH
:
ssh -p 2223 root@localhost
(password:
rootpass
)
Worker2 SSH
:
ssh -p 2224 root@localhost
(password:
rootpass
)
Non-privileged User
:
user
(password:
password
) - recommended for job
submission
⚠️
Security Note
: SSH keys are automatically generated during container
build for testing and educational purposes only. Do not use these keys in
production environments.
In the example compose file, SSH is bound to the host's localhost only,
preventing remote access from different hosts.
Example SLURM Commands
#
Check cluster status
sinfo
#
Submit a test job as user
su - user
srun hostname
#
Submit MPI job (intra-node)
module load mpi/openmpi-x86_64
sbatch -N 1 -n 4 --wrap=
"
mpirun -n 4 hostname
"
#
Submit MPI job (inter-node)
sbatch -N 2 -n 4 --wrap=
"
mpirun -n 4 hostname
"
#
View job queue
squeue
#
View job accounting (NEW!)
sacct
#
Show

data.title: NSA and IETF, part 3: Dodging the issues at hand
data.author: upofadown
data.article_summary:
这篇文章是cr.yp.to博客的目录索引，主要内容包括：

1. 多篇批评NSA和IETF在密码学标准化过程中存在审查、腐败、规避问题等行为的文章
2. 对后量子密码学(PQC)标准化的质疑，包括对NIST计算方法和安全分析的批评
3. 关于量子计算、加密算法、专利问题等技术分析
4. 作者对美国政府提起的诉讼及相关加密政策讨论
5. 其他技术主题如编译器优化、随机数生成器、向量化编程等

核心关注点是揭露加密标准制定过程中的权力滥用和技术缺陷，尤其是NSA和IETF在后量子密码标准化中的不当行为。文章时间跨度从2015到2025年，展现了作者长期的技术监督和政策批评立场。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[IETF是否应标准化仅包含ML-KEM的密钥交换方案，以及DJB的反对立场和沟通风格]

不同观点：
• **支持标准化ML-KEM**  
  - 认为标准的存在并不意味着必须广泛使用，可以忽略纯ML-KEM方案，同时保留其他混合方案。  
  - 提到NSA的CNSA 2.0要求纯PQ方案，因此需要标准化以满足政府需求。

  - DJB认为纯PQ方案存在实现漏洞风险（如时序侧信道攻击），应优先考虑混合方案。

主要讨论点：Chromium重新考虑支持JPEG XL格式及其潜在影响

不同观点：
• 支持JPEG XL的观点：
  - JPEG XL提供从JPEG的无损重新压缩最佳迁移路径，支持高达32位每通道的HDR（wizee）
  - JPEG XL是一个完整的图像数据处理方案，可以替代OpenEXR，而AVIF仅适合网络分发（jlouis）
  - JPEG XL对未来20年更有前景（FerritMans）

• 对新技术格式持保留态度：
  - 仅有20%的无损压缩提升可能不值得引入新格式带来的兼容性问题（Pxtl）
  - 即使浏览器支持新格式，其他工具和网站可能不支持，造成用户体验问题（Pxtl）
  - WebP的采用历史表明新格式的广泛采用存在困难（h1fra）

• 技术实现讨论：
  - 期待用Rust开发高性能且内存安全的解码器（wizee）
  - 注意到JPEG XL相关技术（如jpegli）已有显著改进（gen2brain）

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点：JPEG XL相对于AVIF等其他新格式的实际价值（20%压缩提升是否足够）
- 有用户质疑图像格式的持续迭代必要性（gethly："为什么我们要倒退？"）

data.author: OuterVale
data.article_summary: 澳大利亚气象局新网站耗资9650万澳元，远超最初公布的410万澳元，引发公众强烈不满。新网站上线后因导航困难、雷达地图显示不清等问题遭到用户批评，特别是农民无法获取降雨数据。气象局承认总成本包括410万澳元设计费、7980万澳元建设费和1260万澳元安全测试等费用，称重建是为满足现代安全与可访问性要求。环境部长已要求新任局长调查成本失控和功能问题，但暂未判定是否浪费资金。网站现已部分恢复旧版功能，并将继续改进。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：澳大利亚气象局网站重建项目的巨额费用是否合理，以及是否存在欺诈行为。

不同观点：
• **质疑费用合理性**  
  - [TrackerFF] 认为咨询公司可能存在欺诈性超时计费，通过计算指出即使按高额小时费率，费用也过高。  
  - [m4tthumphrey] 和 [sys_64738] 直接批评费用“离谱”，甚至呼吁追究签字人和公司的法律责任。  
  - [tantalor] 对“安全测试”花费1260万澳元提出质疑，认为天气网站的安全需求并不复杂。  

• **归因于外包与管理问题**  
  - [fergie] 指出核心问题是政府外包了软件开发能力，导致依赖咨询公司和高额成本。  
  - [oliwarner] 强调部门应内部组建团队，而非外包，认为签字人应承担法律责任。  
  - [BigJono] 从行业视角分析，认为费用膨胀源于长期项目、高薪团队、管理混乱和低效技术栈（如Java、C#），而非欺诈。  

• **技术层面的批评**  
  - [evolve2k] 通过技术分析指出网站使用过时的技术栈（如Perl），可能遗留旧系统问题。  
  - [sandorscribbles] 以类似案例（FAA的NOTAM系统）说明政府项目常因多层分包和仓促决策导致低质量交付。  

补充讨论：  
- **争议焦点**：费用是否合理（如安全测试成本） vs. 项目复杂性是否被低估（如后端数据链和超级计算机整合）。  
- **讽刺与调侃**：[eviks] 调侃应直接花费10亿澳元并加入AI噱头，[lunias] 提出可代为谈判节省费用。  
- **对比案例**：[TrackerFF] 提到挪威天气网站yr.no仅需10-12名开发者，凸显成本差异。

46033435.article_content:
Bureau of Meteorology's new boss asked to examine $96.5m bill for website redesign
By
Jean Kennedy
Topic:
Weather Forecasts
Sun 23 Nov
Sunday 23 November
Sun 23 Nov 2025 at 7:04am
The Bureau of Meteorology has revealed the total cost of its new website was about $96.5 million.
(
ABC News: Greg Bigelow
)
In short:
The Bureau of Meteorology revealed its new website cost $96.5 million, not $4.1 million as the agency had originally said.
The weather agency said the website needed a "complete rebuild" to meet "modern security, usability and accessibility requirements".
The federal minister for the environment has asked the bureau's new boss to "to get on top" of the cost and functionality.
abc.net.au/news/bureau-of-meteorology-new-website-cost-blowout-to-96-million/106042202
Link copied
Share
Share
article
The Bureau of Meteorology's (BOM) flawed and expensive redesigned website will come under renewed scrutiny, with the federal environment minister asking the agency's new boss to closely examine how it all went so wrong, and report back to him.
It comes amid revelations that the new website cost more than $96 million to design — a far cry from the $4 million figure it originally claimed had been spent.
The national weather
agency was flooded with complaints
by the public after the website was launched a month ago.
Users found it difficult to navigate, and also criticised the
changes to the radar map
, which made place names hard to read.
BOM users, farmers in particular, were critical of the changes made to the radar map.
(
ABC Rural: Justine Longmore
)
Farmers were scathing, as they were unable to locate rainfall data.
The federal government was forced to intervene, ordering the agency to fix the website.
The site has since reverted to the old version of the radar map and other tweaks have been made to the site, with further changes to be rolled out.
In a statement provided to the ABC, the BOM admitted "the total cost of the website is approximately $96.5 million".
'Complete rebuild necessary'
It said the cost breakdown included $4.1 million for the redesign, $79.8 million for the website build, and the site's launch and security testing cost $12.6 million.
"A complete rebuild was necessary to ensure the website meets modern security, usability and accessibility requirements for the millions of Australians who reply on it every day," a spokesperson said.
The spokesperson also said it had "continued to listen to and analyse community feedback" since the launch of the new website on October 22.
The BOM says it continues to listen to and analyse community feedback.
(
ABC News: Greg Bigelow
)
Nine days after the launch it changed the radar map back to what it had previously been.
"This brought back the visual style that the community said they found intuitive and reliable for interpreting weather conditions,"
a spokesperson said.
"This option was already available on the new site but not as the default setting when visiting the page.
"On 7 November we implemented changes to help the community find important fire behaviour index information."
Future changes were also in the pipeline in response to community feedback, according to the spokesperson, but some updates had been paused due to Severe Tropical Cyclone Fina in northern Australia.
Minister's expectations 'have been made very clear'
Environment Minister Murray Watt said he had met twice in the past week with the new CEO Stuart Minchin to reiterate his concerns about the bungled process and the cost.
The environment minister says he has met twice with the BOM's new boss.
(
ABC News: Callum Flinn
)
He has asked Mr Minchin to report back to him on the issue.
"I don't think it's secret that I haven't been happy with the way the BOM has handled the transition to the new website," he told reporters on Sunday.
"I met with him on his first day and during the week just gone, to outline again that I think the BOM hasn't met public expectations, both in terms of the performance of the website and the cost of the website.
"So I've asked him as his first priority to make sure that he can get on top of the issues with the website — the functionality — and I'm pleased to see they've made changes.
"But I've also asked him to get on top of how we got to this position with this cost, with the problems.
"He's only been in the job for a week but I think my expectations have been made very clear."
The minister has asked new BOM boss, Stuart Minchin, to prioritise the issues with the website.
(
Supplied: BOM
)
However the minister stopped short of describing the website as a sheer waste of money, saying he would wait to hear back from Mr Minchin before commenting.
"Before leaping to judgement, I want to see what the new CEO of the BOM has been able to establish as to the reasons for those cost increases and I'll make my judgement at that point in time."
'Another Labor disaster'
BOM ordered to fix new website after complaints
The environment minister Murray Watt has told the bureau

data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者离职后开发一款名为Outcrop的知识库工具的经历。他最初用Go语言快速搭建了原型，但面临扩展和性能问题后转向Rust重写，利用宏等特性减少了代码量。作者特别强调了权限系统的创新设计，借鉴了Google的Zanzibar架构但做了简化，实现了高效的权限检查。文章还提到当前市场机遇（如Atlassian产品调整）和欧洲数据合规优势，表明该产品定位为企业级Confluence替代方案，注重速度、简洁性和实时协作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[对Notion替代品的需求和现有工具的评价]

不同观点：
• 对开源Notion替代品的需求：xanth希望有一个开源的Notion替代品，能够将数据同步到一个统一的图中，并支持更计算友好的格式。arnaudsm则批评现有技术巨头（如Gmail、Notion、Facebook）的延迟问题。
• 数据所有权和便携性：braza强调数据所有权的重要性，不喜欢专有格式，倾向于可以自由推送和检索数据的工具。hexo则提到org-mode的满意度，但对2D笔记功能有未满足的需求。
• 性能和扩展性：sgarland对作者的性能优化表示赞赏，但对大规模应用的扩展性表示怀疑，特别是关于Postgres存储策略和TOAST开销的问题。
• 用户体验和功能设计：hresvelgr认为Notion的成功在于让用户轻松创建美观的实时文档，但对其中加入RDBMS功能表示不满，建议保持文档格式简单。
• 技术实现细节：nixpulvis对权限管理的实现方式提出疑问，Sytten则建议将prosemirror端口作为开源库发布。

补充讨论：
• 其他工具的比较：hexo提到尝试过Obsidian和其他软件，但最终选择了org-mode，显示用户对工具的偏好多样化。
• 商业和开源的选择：braza指出Notion适合企业用户，但作为消费者更倾向于开源或可移植的工具。
• 争议焦点：性能和扩展性（sgarland的观点）与用户体验和功能设计（hresvelgr的观点）之间存在潜在的冲突，即如何在保持高性能的同时提供丰富的用户体验。

45985306.article_content:
I built an actually faster Notion in Rust
I’m building
Outcrop
. If your team’s looking for a Confluence alternative, sign up for
early access
or become an
early sponsor
.
Eight months ago I left my job at Stripe to build a knowledge base. I had sat out the urge to do this for years by then. There have been many attempts at building a faster alternative, some of them mine. I don’t think any of them came close to getting it done.
What does it mean to build a better knowledge base? By the time I left my job, I had worked across many teams, built some knowledge systems, maintained some others, and read a whole lot of them. Stripe was the first company I worked at that had this figured out; they got themselves a team to build their own internal knowledge base, with search bridging the gap to other services.
As it turns out, all you need is speed and simplicity. Teams owned one or more spaces, and you didn’t have to remember where’s what, as you could find it with a quick search. Your team got assigned a task whenever a document went out of date.
The timing couldn’t be more right. Linear had already figured this out for product management. Many documentation tools gave up on building a good product and shifted their focus to competing with chat interfaces. Atlassian is sunsetting their Data Center offering, a once in a lifetime event that lets you swoop in and sign up their largest customers. Regulations over data residency have been tightening in Europe, and it helps to be an Irish company.
How do you build a simpler product? Counterintuitively, you start by building a much more complex one. It’s easy to wrap a database in a theme and call it a week, but you’d hit the same scaling issues as the next tool.
This is not where your favourite language comes in. I started by wrapping a database in a theme, in a week. I used Go and it’s a nice little language. But a couple of weeks in, I was writing more code for generating code than actual application code. There are many parts to a knowledge base, and no one has the time to write all the boilerplate. If you’re building a progressively complex system, you better have some automated way to know when services aren’t compatible anymore. By this point, I’ve decided that users should be able to collaborate in real time, and I wasn’t satisfied with search latency, and querying the database to check who can do what was getting tiresome. This is where your favourite language comes in.

It didn’t take long to rewrite everything in Rust. Somehow I ended up with fewer lines of code as I replaced my handwritten bits for generating code with macro crates. What looked like a soup of text is now a more readable

A tiny Zanzibar
With Rust in my toolbox, or rather, being my toolbox, there were so many bits I could now at least dream of building, and stay up for nights making a reality. A while ago, Google wrote about their Zanzibar authorisation system. I was getting fed up with querying the database on each call to make sure your man can actually access the page they’re requesting. There were already some open source implementations inspired by Google’s architecture, however, they felt a bit overwhelming. It’s straightforward to launch a new Docker container, but you’ve now taken on the burden of maintaining and debugging a service that might not be as documented or as supported as you might need.
The concepts behind Zanzibar are compelling; abstract your authorisation system away from your usual database queries and application code. I chose to build a tinier version of it. It’s not decentralised, it’s persisted to Postgres, but loaded in memory on startup. It doesn’t have a complicated configuration language; I already know my entities. The relation is defined in a
csv
file right next to the code.

read|list,
page|comment
Permissions are inheritable. Being a member of a team with access to a certain space immediately gives you access to that same space. Services can invoke the authorization system with a single macro call.

(user_id,
Editor
,
Page
(page_id));
must!
(user_id,
Page
(page_id),
Update
);

data.title: I put a real search engine into a Lambda, so you only pay when you search
data.author: shutty
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[在Lambda上使用Lucene和GraalVM原生二进制的可行性与替代方案]

不同观点：
• [支持并分享经验]
  - gunnarmorling分享了自己在个人博客中使用Lucene和GraalVM原生二进制文件的经验，认为这种方法效果不错，并提到曾考虑使用RAMDirectory嵌入索引但未实现。
  - psanford提到使用Quickwit作为低成本搜索引擎的成功经验，尽管未来可能不再支持Lambda部署模式。
  - infecto赞赏此类工作，指出搜索在现代应用中的重要性和高成本问题。

• [技术疑问]
  - billconan提出疑问：为什么索引器不能直接写入EFS，而要通过S3中转？
  - ncgl对文章中提到Lambda内存限制的问题提出质疑，询问是否是在10GB内存Lambda广泛可用之前写的。

• [幽默与讽刺]
  - hashmap以幽默方式提到“无服务器”架构的成功，并调侃性地提到“无计算机”架构的开发。

补充讨论：
• [争议点]
  - Lambda内存限制问题（ncgl的疑问）可能引发关于AWS Lambda功能更新和可用性的讨论。
  - 索引写入路径的选择（billconan的疑问）可能涉及性能、成本或技术限制的讨论。

• [替代方案与未来方向]
  - psanford提到Quickwit的未来不支持Lambda部署，暗示可能需要寻找其他替代方案。
  - gunnarmorling和infecto的讨论突出了自建搜索解决方案的复杂性和高成本问题。

data.author: petethomas

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Meta Platforms在路易斯安那州建设数据中心并通过债务融资，但相关债务和资产不计入公司资产负债表的行为是否合理和可持续。

不同观点：
• 批评观点：认为Meta Platforms通过会计手段将债务和资产移出资产负债表是一种欺骗行为，旨在掩盖真实的财务风险。这种激进的会计选择可能导致未来财务问题，尤其是如果项目出现问题，债务仍需由Meta承担，但表面上却不反映在资产负债表中。
• 技术性观点：虽然这种做法在会计和法律上可能是合规的，但道德和透明度存疑。文章暗示这种做法可能只是为了美化财务报表，而非真实的财务健康表现。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：这种会计处理是否属于欺骗行为，还是合法的财务优化手段。
• 其他讨论点：这种做法对投资者和市场的潜在影响，以及未来是否可能引发财务或法律风险。

data.title: Jimmy Cliff, Jamaican reggae singer, actor and cultural icon, dies aged 81
data.author: gfortaine
data.article_summary: 牙买加雷鬼乐传奇歌手、演员吉米·克利夫（Jimmy Cliff）于2025年11月24日去世，享年81岁。他的妻子在Instagram上宣布其因癫痫发作后感染肺炎离世。克利夫以《You Can Get It If You Really Want》等经典歌曲和1972年电影《不速之客》闻名全球，是将雷鬼乐推向世界的重要人物，曾获牙买加功绩勋章。他1944年出生于牙买加圣詹姆斯，1960年代开始音乐生涯，作品融合欢快节奏与社会议题，深刻影响了牙买加文化的国际传播。晚年他皈依伊斯兰教，持续创作至生命最后阶段。牙买加总理称其为"将国家精神传向世界的文化巨人"。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Jimmy Cliff的音乐作品及其翻唱版本的比较，以及相关电影的推荐]

不同观点：

• [第二种观点] johng表示这是自己最喜欢的Jimmy Cliff歌曲，并提到它是通过电影《Marked for Death》的原声带听到的，附上了YouTube链接。
• [第三种观点] djohnston称赞电影《The Harder They Come》非常出色，但遗憾地表示这是他看过的少数加勒比电影之一，并询问其他人是否有类似的电影推荐。

补充讨论：[其他值得注意的讨论点]

• djohnston的评论引发了关于加勒比电影推荐的讨论，这可能是另一个潜在的热点。

Jimmy Cliff photographed in 2021.
Photograph: Vision Addict
View image in fullscreen
Jimmy Cliff photographed in 2021.
Photograph: Vision Addict
Jimmy Cliff
Jimmy Cliff, Jamaican reggae singer, actor and cultural icon, dies aged 81
Star of The Harder They Come had hits including You Can Get It If You Really Want and I Can See Clearly Now
Ben Beaumont-Thomas
Mon 24 Nov 2025 06.45 EST
Last modified on Mon 24 Nov 2025 09.46 EST
Share
Jimmy Cliff, the singer and actor whose mellifluous voice helped to turn reggae into a global phenomenon, has died aged 81.
A message from his wife Latifa Chambers on Instagram reads: “It’s with profound sadness that I share that my husband, Jimmy Cliff, has crossed over due to a seizure followed by pneumonia. I am thankful for his family, friends, fellow artists and coworkers who have shared his journey with him. To all his fans around the world, please know that your support was his strength throughout his whole career … Jimmy, my darling, may you rest in peace. I will follow your wishes.” Her message was also signed by their children, Lilty and Aken.
With hits including You Can Get It If You Really Want, I Can See Clearly Now and Wonderful World, Beautiful People, Cliff’s upbeat musical temperament brought him a large and longstanding fanbase. His lead acting role in 1972 crime drama The Harder They Come was also acclaimed, with the film seen as a cornerstone of Jamaican cinema.
He is one of just a handful of musicians, alongside Bob Marley and others, to be awarded the Jamaican Order of Merit.
Jamaican prime minister Andrew Holness was among those paying tribute to Cliff, calling him “a true cultural giant whose music carried the heart of our nation to the world … Jimmy Cliff told our story with honesty and soul. His music lifted people through hard times, inspired generations, and helped to shape the global respect that Jamaican culture enjoys today.”
View image in fullscreen
Jimmy Cliff signing autographs for The Harder They Come.
Photograph: Michael Ochs Archives/Getty Images
Cliff was born in Saint James, Jamaica in 1944, and his music career began in the early 1960s after he moved to the island’s capital Kingston and began collaborating with producer Leslie Kong. Kong’s family owned a record shop called Beverley’s and Cliff wrote a song namechecking it to help persuade Kong – who would go on to become key producer in reggae – to work with him.
He had a number of local hits and was selected as a Jamaican representative at the World’s Fair expo in New York in 1964, but his career really took off later that decade after he signed to Island Records.
He was initially marketed to a rock crowd – hence curios such as his cover of Whiter Shade of Pale – and found life in his new home of London alienating, later describing the city as “a bitch … I experienced racism in a manner I had never experienced before”. But the sparkling ska of 1969’s Wonderful World, Beautiful People proved to be his breakthrough UK hit, reaching No 6 in the charts.
Its message of hope and unity carried with it a rebuke of the current state of the world (“cheating, backbiting, scandalising and hating”) and that blend of beautiful music and socially conscious lyrics became a core part of Cliff’s artistry. After writing Vietnam, a song pleading for the end to that war, Cliff later recalled: “The critics in London said, ‘Wow! How is he singing this kind of serious song and such a happy rhythm?’ And I said: Wow! I didn’t even realise I was doing that. I was just writing a song to a rhythm.”
Cliff was back in the UK Top 10 in 1970 with a cover of Cat Stevens’s Wild World, before filming The Harder They Come in 1972, after the film’s director Perry Henzell intuited that he would make a good actor.
View image in fullscreen
Cliff in the 1972 film The Harder They Come.
Photograph: Ronald Grant Archive
Its soundtrack album, with Cliff performances such as the title track and You Can Get It If You Really Want alongside others by Desmond Dekker, Toots & the Maytals and more, helped to bring reggae to a wider audience, especially in the US where the film was eventually released in 1973.
The film’s gangster milieu was familiar to Cliff, as he recalled in the Observer in 2022: “When I came to Kingston I lived in areas that were gangster-infested, and to be quite honest, the only thing that stopped me from joining those gangs full-time was I didn’t know where I would bury my head if my family heard that I was in Kingston firing a gun.”
Cliff continued to tour and release albums in the 1970s, and had high-profile appearances in the US such as a booking on Saturday Night Live. He took some time away from music in the mid-late 1970s, travelling to Africa to reconnect with his ancestral roots, and converting to Islam: the 1978 album Give Thankx was partly inspired by those travels.

• [第二种观点] johng表示这是自己最喜欢的Jimmy Cliff歌曲，并提到它是通过电影《Marked for Death》的原声带听到的，附上了YouTube链接。
• [第三种观点] djohnston称赞电影《The Harder They Come》非常出色，但遗憾地表示这是他看过的少数加勒比电影之一，并询问其他人是否有类似的电影推荐。

补充讨论：[其他值得注意的讨论点]
• 争议的焦点可能在于Jimmy Cliff的翻唱版本是否真的比原版更优秀，但评论中没有直接的对立讨论。
• djohnston的评论引发了关于加勒比电影推荐的讨论，这可能是另一个潜在的热点。

主要讨论点：[MCP（可能指某种AI交互协议）应用和UI集成的价值与方向]

不同观点：
• **支持MCP UI集成**（如felixrieseberg）：认为这是让普通用户无需了解技术细节即可受益的关键步骤，类比浏览器隐藏了HTTP/DNS的复杂性。目标是降低使用门槛，扩大用户群体。
• **反对静态UI绑定**（如mindwok、CuriouslyC）：认为LLM的核心优势是动态交互，静态UI会削弱灵活性。主张通过API直接连接系统代理，实现实时操作，而非嵌入固定界面。
• **生态碎片化风险**（如hobofan）：担心新扩展会加剧协议分裂，现有核心功能尚未普及，过早添加复杂功能可能导致兼容性问题。
• **重复发明质疑**（如no_circuit）：指出类似功能（如聊天界面嵌入UI）已有20年历史，批评社区在重复谷歌助手、Alexa等产品的老路。

1. **技术方向**：动态LLM交互 vs. 静态UI嵌入孰优孰劣。

• **可靠性问题**（如WillAdams）：提出LLM处理批任务的错误率，建议引入类似"双密钥校验"的容错机制。

46020502.article_content:
Today we’re introducing the proposal for the
MCP Apps Extension
(
SEP-1865
) to standardize support for interactive user interfaces in the Model Context Protocol.
This extension addresses one of the most requested features from the MCP community and builds on proven work from
MCP-UI
and
OpenAI Apps SDK
- the
ability for MCP servers to deliver interactive user interfaces to hosts
.
MCP Apps Extension introduces a standardized pattern for declaring UI resources, linking them to tools, and enabling bidirectional communication between embedded interfaces and the host application.
The SEP was authored by MCP Core Maintainers at OpenAI and Anthropic, together with the MCP-UI creators and lead maintainers of the MCP UI Community Working Group.
Standardization for interactive interfaces
#
Currently, MCP servers are limited to exchanging text and structured data with hosts. While this works well for many use cases, it creates friction when tools need to present visual information or gather complex user input.
For example, consider a data visualization MCP server that returns chart data as JSON. The host application must interpret that data and render it. Handling all kinds of specialized data in this scenario translates to a significant burden for client developers, who would need to build their own logic to render the UI. As more UI requirements come up, like the need to collect multiple related settings from users, the complexity balloons. Alternatively, without UI support, these interactions become awkward exchanges of text prompts and responses.
The MCP community has been creative in working around these limitations, but different implementations using varying conventions and architectures make it harder for servers to work consistently across clients. This lack of standardization creates a real risk of ecosystem fragmentation - something we’re working to proactively prevent.
Building together
#
The
MCP-UI project
, created by
Ido Salomon
and
Liad Yosef
and maintained by a dedicated community, spearheaded the vision of agentic apps with interactive interfaces. The project developed patterns for delivering rich user interfaces as first-class MCP resources, proving that agentic apps fit naturally within the MCP architecture. The project is backed by a large community and provides
rich SDKs
, adopted at leading companies and projects such as Postman, Shopify, Hugging Face, Goose, and ElevenLabs.
The
OpenAI Apps SDK
further validated the demand for rich UI experiences within conversational AI interfaces. The SDK enables developers to build rich, interactive applications inside ChatGPT using MCP as its backbone. To ensure interoperability and establish consistent security and usage patterns across the ecosystem, Anthropic, OpenAI, and MCP-UI are collaborating to create an official MCP extension for interactive interfaces.
MCP Apps Extension specification
#
We’re proposing a specification for UI resources in MCP, but the implications go further than just a set of schema changes. The MCP Apps Extension is starting to look like an agentic app runtime: a foundation for novel interactions between AI models, users, and applications. The proposal is intentionally lean, starting with core patterns that we plan on expanding over time.
Key design decisions
#
Pre-declared resources
#
UI templates are resources with the
ui://
URI scheme, referenced in tool metadata.
// Server registers UI resource
{
uri
:
"ui://charts/bar-chart"
,
name
:
"Bar Chart Viewer"
,
mimeType
:
"text/html+mcp"
}
// Tool references it in metadata
{
name
:
"visualize_data_as_bar_chart"
,
description
:
"Plots some data as a bar chart"
,
inputSchema
:
{
type
:
"object"
,
properties
:
{
series
:
{
type
:
"array"
,
items
:
....
}
}
},
_meta
:
{
"ui/resourceUri"
:
"ui://charts/bar-chart"
,
}
}
This approach enables hosts to prefetch and review templates before tool execution, improving both performance and security. It also separates static presentation (the template) from dynamic data (tool results), enabling better caching.
MCP transport for communication
#
Instead of inventing a custom message protocol, UI components communicate with hosts using existing MCP JSON-RPC base protocol over
postMessage
. This means that:
UI developers can use the standard
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk
to build their applications
All communication is structured and auditable
Future MCP features automatically work with the UI extension
Starting with HTML
#
The initial extension specification supports only
text/html
content, rendered in sandboxed
iframes
. This provides:
Universal browser support
Well-understood security model
Screenshot and preview generation capabilities
A clear baseline for future extensions
Other content types such as external URLs, remote DOM, and native widgets are explicitly deferred to future iterations.
Security-first
#
Hosting interactive content from MCP servers requires careful security consideration. The proposal addresses this through multiple layers:
Ifra

data.title: Windows ARM64 Internals: Deconstructing Pointer Authentication
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary:
本文主要介绍了ARM架构中的指针验证码(PAC)技术及其在Windows系统中的实现。PAC是一种防漏洞/内存损坏功能，通过在指针中嵌入加密签名来验证指针的有效性。文章详细讲解了：
1. PAC的基本原理：利用64位地址中未使用的位(48-63)存储签名信息
2. ARM架构支持：从Armv8.3-A和Armv9.0-A开始支持，使用专用系统寄存器存储签名密钥
3. Windows实现：系统启动时通过加载器参数块确定PAC支持，并初始化内核模式指针签名密钥
4. 密钥管理：Windows目前仅使用密钥B来签名指令指针，并将密钥存储在APIBKey系统寄存器中
5. 特权级别：虽然用户模式和内核模式共享EL1的签名密钥寄存器，但用户模式(EL0)无法直接访问该寄存器
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[内存安全技术的现状与未来发展]

不同观点：
• 支持现有技术的观点
  - ARM的Memory Tagging Extension (MTE)和CHERI架构为现有代码提供了补充防御。
  - MTE虽然当前在Windows设备上未实现，但未来可能会显著提高内存损坏攻击的成本。
  - LLVM的MemTagSanitizer基于Armv8.5-A MTE，预计能以低开销检测内存错误。

• 对现有技术局限性的批评
  - 当前Surface Pro等ARM64设备未支持MTE功能。
  - MemTagSanitizer仍处于开发阶段，相关硬件尚未普及（截至2019年10月）。
  - 需要更多实际应用和验证来证明这些技术的有效性。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：MTE技术的实际部署时间表和效果。
• 相关工具链：Google的sanitizers项目已并入LLVM，包括AddressSanitizer等工具。
• 学术研究支持："Color My World"论文提出了指针安全标记的新方法。
• 行业动态：Linux已开始支持Arm64 MTE，显示出技术逐步落地的趋势。

46018664.article_content:
Pointer Authentication Code
, or PAC, is an anti-exploit/memory-corruption feature that signs pointers so their use (as code or data) can be validated at runtime. PAC is available on Armv8.3-A and Armv9.0-A (and later) ARM architectures and leverages virtual addressing in order to store a small cryptographic signature alongside the pointer value.
On a typical 64-bit processor a pointer is considered a "user-mode" pointer if bit 47 of a 64-bit address is set to 0 (meaning, then, bits 48-63 are also 0). This is known as a
canonical
user-mode address. If bit 47 is set to 1, bits 48-63 are also set to 1, with this being considered a canonical
kernel-mode
address. Additionally, LA57, ARM 52 or 56 bit, or similar processors extend the most significant bit out even further (and PAC can also be enabled in the ARM-specific scenarios). For our purposes, however, we will be looking at a typical 64-bit processor with the most significant bit being bit 47.
It has always been an "accepted" standard that the setting of the most significant bit denotes a user-mode or kernel-mode address â with even some hardware vendors, like Intel, formalizing this architecture in actual hardware with CPU features like Linear Address Space Separation (LASS). This means that bits 48-63 are unused on a current, standard 64-bit processor, as the OS typically ignores them. Because they are unused, this allows PAC to store the aforementioned signature in these unused bits alongside the pointer itself.
As mentioned, these âunusedâ bits are now used to store signing information about a particular pointer in order to validate and verify execution and/or data access to the target memory address. Special CPU instructions are used to both generate and validate cryptographic signatures associated with a particular pointer value. This blog post will examine the Windows implementation of PAC on ARM64 installations of Windows, which, as we will see, supports a very specific implementation of PAC in both user-mode and kernel-mode.
PAC Enablement on Windows
PAC enablement on Windows begins at the entry point of ntoskrnl.exe, KiSystemStartup. KiSystemStartup is responsible for determining if PAC is supported on Windows and also for initializing basic PAC support. KiSystemStartup receives the
loader parameter block
(LOADER_PARAMETER_BLOCK) from winload.efi, the Windows boot loader. The loader block denotes if PAC is supported. Specifically, the
loader parameter block extension
(LOADER_PARAMETER_EXTENSION) portion of the loader block defines a bitmask of various features which are present/supported, so say the boot loader. The PointerAuthKernelIpEnabled bit of this bitmask denotes if PAC is supported. If PAC is supported, the loader parameter block extension is also responsible for providing the initial PAC signing key (PointerAuthKernelIpKey) used to sign and authenticate all kernel-mode pointers (we will see later that the "current" signing key is updated many times). When execution is occurring in kernel-mode, this is the key used to sign kernel-mode pointers. The bootloader generates the key in OslPrepareTarget by calling the function SymCryptRngAesGenerate to generate the initial kernel pointer signing key passed via the loader parameter block.
The ARM architecture supports having
multiple
signing keys for different scenarios, like signing instruction pointers or data pointers with
different
keys. Typically, "key A" and "key B" (as they are referred to), which are stored in specific system registers, are used for signing pointers used in instruction executions (like return addresses). Windows currently only uses PAC for "instruction pointers" (more on this later) and it also it only uses "key B" for cryptographic signatures and, therefore, loads the target pointer signing value into the
APIBKeyLo_EL1 and APIBKeyHi_EL AArch64 system registers
. These "key registers" are specific system registers, which are special registers on ARM systems which control various behaviors/controls/statuses for the system, and are responsible for maintaining the current keys used for signing and authenticating pointers. These two registers ("lo" and hi") each hold a single 64-bit value, which results in a concatenated 128-bit key. EL1, in this case, refers to
exception level
â1â - which denotes the ARM-equivalent of âprivilege levelâ the CPU is running in (as ARM-based CPUs are âexception-oritentedâ, meaning system calls, interrupts, etc. are all treated as âexceptionsâ). Typically EL1 is associated with kernel-mode. User-mode and kernel-mode, for Windows, share EL1âs signing key register (although the "current" signing key in the register changes depending on if a processor is executing in kernel-mode or user-mode). It should be noted that although the signing key for user-mode is stored in an EL1 register, the register itself (e.g., reading/writing) is
inaccessible
from user-mode (EL 0).

data.title: Ubuntu LTS releases to 15 years with Legacy add-on
data.author: taubek
data.article_summary: Canonical宣布将Ubuntu Pro的Legacy附加服务扩展至15年，覆盖从Ubuntu 14.04 LTS开始的长期支持版本。该扩展为高度监管或依赖硬件的行业提供了持续的安全补丁、合规工具和系统支持，无需强制升级。用户可获得15年的安全维护窗口（5年标准维护+5年扩展维护+5年Legacy附加服务），期间保持系统稳定性和兼容性。当前订阅用户无需重新注册即可自动享受延长期限。该服务在标准维护结束后启用，价格为Ubuntu Pro标准价格的1.5倍。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[Ubuntu推出15年长期支持（LTS）版本的利弊及行业影响]

不同观点：
• 支持长期支持（LTS）版本的观点：
  - 认为LTS版本对基础设施和企业至关重要，尤其对无法频繁升级的系统（如关键基础设施和家庭自动化系统）提供了稳定性。
  - 举例说明某些行业（如PCI合规要求的信用卡行业）需要长期支持，尽管存在审核和合规性挑战。
  - 提到个人用户（如软件定义无线电用户）依赖稳定版本运行特定软件，避免升级带来的兼容性问题。
  - 提到Ubuntu的Extended Long Term Support（ELTS）为商业用户提供了10年支持，进一步延长了系统寿命。

• 反对长期支持版本的观点：
  - 认为长期支持是技术和组织失败的体现，无法定期升级会导致系统积累大量遗留问题，最终需要大规模重构或迁移。
  - 指出长期支持版本可能导致维护困难，尤其是当全球技术环境已经向前发展时。
  - 举例说明某些工具（如Firefox）在旧版本上可能无法正常工作，限制了LTS版本的实用性。

• 其他重要观点：
  - 讨论容器技术（如Incus/LXC）如何帮助在保持主机系统更新的同时，运行长期支持的旧版本。
  - 比较不同发行版（如Ubuntu和RHEL）的长期支持策略，提到RHEL最长支持13年，而Ubuntu此次推出15年支持。
  - 提到Year 2038问题（64位时间戳）对长期支持版本的影响，以及实际部署中的测试需求。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点：长期支持版本是否真的解决了企业需求，还是仅仅延缓了不可避免的技术债务问题。
- 讨论中提到Ubuntu的Pro支持计划对个人用户免费，这一点受到欢迎，但也有人质疑其实际覆盖范围是否足够广泛。
- 部分用户对频繁升级感到疲惫，倾向于滚动发布版本，但切换成本较高。

Expansion ensures business continuity without forcing major upgrades
Today, Canonical announced the expansion of the Legacy add-on for Ubuntu Pro, extending total coverage for Ubuntu LTS releases to 15 years. Starting with Ubuntu 14.04 LTS (Trusty Tahr), this extension brings the full benefits of Ubuntu Pro – including continuous security patching, compliance tooling and support for your OS – to long-lived production systems.
In highly regulated or hardware-dependent industries, upgrades threaten to disrupt tightly controlled security and compliance. For many organizations, maintaining production systems for more than a decade is complex, but remains a more sensible option than a full upgrade.
That’s why, in 2024, we first
introduced the Legacy add-on
for Ubuntu Pro, starting with Ubuntu 14.04 LTS (Trusty Tahr). The Legacy add-on increased the total maintenance window for Ubuntu LTS releases to 12 years: five years of standard security maintenance, five years of Expanded Security Maintenance (ESM), and two years of additional coverage with the Legacy add-on – with optional support throughout. Due to the positive reception and growing interest in longer lifecycle coverage, we’re excited to now extend the Legacy add-on to 5 years, bringing a 15-year security maintenance and support window to Ubuntu LTS releases.
A 15-year lifecycle for stability
Throughout this 15-year window, Ubuntu Pro provides continuous security maintenance across the entire Ubuntu base, kernel, and key open source components. Canonical’s security team actively scans, triages, and backports critical, high, and select medium CVEs to all maintained LTS releases, ensuring security without forcing disruptive major upgrades that break compatibility or require re-certification.
Break/fix support remains an optional add-on. When production issues arise, you can get access to our Support team through this service and troubleshoot with experts who contribute to Ubuntu every day, who’ve seen similar problems before and know how to resolve them quickly.

Realistic timelines for planning and executing major migrations

Current Ubuntu Pro subscriptions will continue uninterrupted. No re-enrollment, no reinstallation, no surprise migration projects.

data.title: Inside Rust's std and parking_lot mutexes – who wins?
data.author: signa11
data.article_summary:
这篇文章比较了Rust标准库的`std::sync::Mutex`和第三方库`parking_lot::Mutex`的实现差异与性能表现。作者深入分析了两种互斥锁的内部机制：

1. `std::Mutex`采用平台相关实现（如Linux的Futex），通过原子操作和系统调用来管理锁状态，支持跨平台但性能可能受限

2. `parking_lot`完全在用户空间实现，使用更高效的算法，减少了系统调用开销

通过基准测试发现`parking_lot`在多数场景下性能更优，内存占用更小，但`std::Mutex`在跨平台兼容性和错误处理（如中毒机制）方面更有优势。

最后作者提供了选择建议：对性能要求高的单平台应用推荐`parking_lot`，需要跨平台或更稳健错误处理的场景则选择标准库实现。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust标准库中互斥锁（Mutex）的设计和替代方案

不同观点：
• **原生系统锁 vs. 自定义锁（如parking_lot）**  
  - 原生系统锁（如futex/SRW）的优点是避免内存分配的循环依赖问题，且能利用内核的调试功能（如Linux/Windows）。  
  - parking_lot的优势在于锁体积小（如2-bit锁），适合细粒度锁场景（如JavaScriptCore的对象头嵌入锁），但依赖全局哈希表的内存分配，可能引发循环依赖问题。  

• **锁中毒（Poisoning）的争议**  
  - Rust标准库的锁中毒机制被批评为设计缺陷，认为其实际用途有限且易导致服务拒绝攻击（DoS），常见做法是忽略或直接解包（`unwrap`）。  
  - 反对观点认为，中毒机制在特定场景下（如低层级操作）可能提供必要的panic安全保证，但需开发者明确处理。  

• **平台差异与性能权衡**  
  - 不同平台（如Apple新增futex支持）的锁实现可能牺牲特性（如优先级反转避免）。  
  - 公平性设计的锁在竞争下标准差更低，但性能略逊（如文章中的C++示例争议）。  

补充讨论：  
- 高层抽象替代方案（如MPSC队列、RCU）被推荐给非性能敏感代码，以减少对底层锁的直接依赖。  
- 开发者对锁的选择需权衡性能、安全性和平台兼容性（如parking_lot的性能优势 vs. 标准库的稳定性）。  
- 争议焦点集中在中毒机制的实用性和自定义锁的内存分配问题。

Inside Rust's std and parking_lot mutexes - who wins?
A teardown of Rust's mutex internals plus real benchmarks so you know when to choose std or parking_lot.
Cuong Le
Oct 30, 2025
21
2
Share
A while ago, our team was working on a Rust project where
std::sync::Mutex
was everywhere. A team member suggested switching to
parking_lot::Mutex
instead. They heard that it has better performance, smaller memory footprint, and more predictable behavior under contention.
I had no idea how to evaluate this claim. A quick search online returned results favoring parking_lot. This felt wrong to me. Why? It contradicted my belief that std should be the gold standard. The standard library team knows what they’re doing, right? And if parking_lot’s mutex really was the performance winner, there had to be trade-offs between the two implementations that people weren’t talking about.
That mystery haunted me. I couldn’t just take it on faith. So I jumped down the rabbit hole: read both implementations, wrote the benchmarks, and here we are. In this post, I will:
Explain how std implements the mutex (v1.90.0)
Explain how parking_lot implements their mutex (v0.12.5)
Show you the benchmark with key findings
Give you a decision guide for when to use each
But first, let’s ground our foundation on mutexes (skim it if you’re already familiar).
What Is a Mutex, Really?
A classic example of the kind of problem that mutex solves is withdrawing and receiving money at the same time. Imagine you have $100 in your account. Thread A tries to withdraw $80, and Thread B tries to deposit $50. Without proper synchronization, both threads might read the balance as $100 simultaneously, then write back their results independently:
Mutex solves this nicely by having a thread wait until the other finishes its update:
The operations that read and write the balance are what we need to protect - these are called
critical sections
. Any code that accesses shared data needs to be inside a critical section, guarded by a mutex.
Simple enough, right? Now let’s see how to use a mutex. (Again, skim this if it’s too basic for you)
How to use mutex
In languages other than Rust, you typically declare a mutex separately from your data, then manually lock it before entering the critical section and unlock it afterward. Here’s how it looks in C++:
The problem? Nothing stops you from accessing
account
without locking the mutex first. The compiler won’t catch this bug.
Rust takes a completely different approach - the mutex wraps and owns the data:
Three things to pay close attention to:
The mutex wraps the data
: This makes it impossible to access
account
without holding the lock. The compiler enforces this.
Automatic unlock
: When you lock, you receive a guard. When the guard goes out of scope, it automatically unlocks. No manual cleanup needed.
Lock can fail
: Notice the
.unwrap()
on
.lock()
? It returns a
Result
because locking can fail due to poisoning. I’ll explain this shortly.
That’s enough of the basics. Let’s have some fun. Here is how mutex is implemented, starting with Rust std.
Want more like this? Rust and systems, from real work. Every two weeks.
Subscribe
How Rust’s std::Mutex Works
Overview
A quick look into std::Mutex gives us this
data
is the easy part. Since the mutex enforces exclusive access, Rust uses UnsafeCell to give you safe mutable access once it’s locked.
poison
is just
Atomic<bool>
flag to tell if the last thread acquired the lock panic. So, maybe you would want to handle it next time you lock it.
inner
is interesting part, let’s look at it next. The code is really long, so I just show a simplified version here
The main idea is that for different OS (and OS version), Rust uses different Mutex implementation. However, we can divide these implementation to 2 big groups: Futex and other platform primitive.
Futex (short for “fast userspace mutex”) is used where the OS kernels expose a “wait on this address” API. We will dive deeper into this one soon.
When that API is missing, Rust falls back to the best available platform traditional locks.
(I’m in awe btw - that’s a lot of different implementations. Writing and maintaining all this platform-specific stuff must be exhausting. Major respect to whoever’s doing this.)
Since Futex is the most used and is quite a typical implementation for Mutex. Let’s look inside it.
Futex
At its heart, futex is just an atomic u32 (simplified here):
Atomic type has this powerful operation called “Compare And Swap” (CAS) where the CPU executes it
in an atomic call
. It works by first comparing the value, if the value equals what is asked for, then it sets the value.
In other words, if we use value 0 for Unlocked state, and 1 for Locked state, we have a simple mutex where the thread can simply try to compare the state to 0 (Unlocked), and set to 1 (Locked). If the state is currently 1, keep doing that until successful.

data.title: SHA1-Hulud the Second Comming – Postman, Zapier, PostHog All Compromised via NPM
data.author: birdculture
data.article_summary: 网络安全公司发现黑客组织"Shai Hulud"于11月24日发起了第二次供应链攻击，主要针对npm生态系统中492个热门软件包（月下载量达1.32亿次）。攻击手法包括：通过安装恶意脚本窃取开发者API密钥和令牌，并将数据上传至GitHub仓库；若认证失败则会删除用户主目录文件。此次攻击规模更大（感染100个包，上次为20个）、技术更复杂（使用bun执行环境），且刻意选在npm即将撤销旧版令牌认证前夕发动。受影响的重要软件包括AsyncAPI、PostHog等多个知名开发工具。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[NPM依赖包安全漏洞及防范措施]

不同观点：
• PNPM比NPM更安全
  - 默认不运行post-install脚本，需手动批准
  - 可设置新包发布的最小等待时间（如4天），让发布者有清理时间
  - 建议使用有限的发布密钥，并绑定到特定包和CI/CD运行器

• 容器化开发环境更安全
  - 在未阅读代码前，应在容器中运行代码，以减少安全隐患

• 减少依赖和简化库
  - 如e18e社区正在减少流行库的依赖，并构建工具来预防和减少攻击影响

• 需要稳定的NPM包流
  - 类似Debian-stable的稳定版本选择，避免频繁更新带来的风险

• 其他安全建议
  - 为发布管理设置独立账户
  - 供应商化依赖（vendor dependencies）
  - 采用Deno-like的安全策略

补充讨论：
• Postman的安全问题
  - 对许多团队来说，Postman是未管理的API密钥密码管理器，存在高风险

• 特定包的影响
  - 某些包（如shinhan-limit-scrap和korea-administrative-area-geo-json-util）在韩国政府和银行服务中广泛使用，影响较大

争议焦点：
• NPM的安全性是否足够用于生产环境
• 是否应该强制实施更严格的发布和依赖管理策略

data.article_summary: 本文介绍了"cool-retro-term"，这是一款模仿老式阴极射线管屏幕风格的终端模拟器，适用于Linux和macOS系统。项目具有美观、可定制和轻量级的特点，使用QML开发，支持调整颜色、字体等效果设置。项目在GitHub上获得24.2k星标，提供AppImage和dmg安装包，也支持从源码构建。文章包含安装说明、截图展示、构建指南以及捐赠支持链接。项目采用GPL许可证，由多位贡献者共同开发。

data.title: Moving from OpenBSD to FreeBSD for firewalls
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 这篇文章作者Chris Siebenmann解释，由于2025年初大量爬虫（可能用于LLM训练）使用老旧浏览器（尤其是Chrome）用户代理访问其博客和CSpace，导致服务器负载过大。为减轻负担，他采取了拦截措施，可能误伤使用旧版浏览器的真实用户。若被误拦，用户可通过其大学邮箱联系说明浏览器版本及User-Agent。特别指出archive.*等网站因使用可疑IP和伪造DNS记录被拦截，建议改用行为规范的archive.org进行网页存档。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[OpenBSD与FreeBSD的pf防火墙性能差异及适用场景]

不同观点：
• OpenBSD的pf性能较差，尤其在10Gbps网络环境下表现不佳，而FreeBSD的pf通过多线程优化性能更好（hapless, kuon, somat）
  - OpenBSD的pf是单线程的，部分在用户空间运行（hapless）
  - FreeBSD的pf在多核环境下表现更佳（somat）
  - 对于小包和状态防火墙，OpenBSD难以处理10Gbps流量（kuon）

• OpenBSD的可靠性问题（popknobinfanny）
  - OpenBSD的文件系统老旧且不稳定，可能导致启动问题
  - 防火墙作为关键基础设施需要更高可靠性

• OpenBSD和FreeBSD的设计哲学差异（somat）
  - OpenBSD注重功能和易用性
  - FreeBSD注重性能和兼容性

• 替代方案讨论（kuon, yuvadam）
  - 商业ASIC防火墙（如Juniper SRX4200）性能更高（kuon）
  - 有人质疑为何不直接使用Linux作为防火墙（yuvadam）

补充讨论：
• OpenBSD最近的TCP处理改进可能提升性能（SoftTalker）
• OpenBSD缺乏长期支持（LTS）版本，对企业不友好（jmclnx）
• 关于从OpenBSD迁移到FreeBSD/Ubuntu的合理性争议（ThinkBeat, Y_Y）
• 开发者对不同系统改进的响应态度差异（dylan604）

45980474.article_content:
You're using a suspiciously old browser
You're probably reading this page because you've attempted to access
some part of
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
or
CSpace
, the wiki thing it's part of. Unfortunately
you're using a browser version that my anti-crawler precautions consider
suspicious, most often because it's too old (most often this applies to
versions of Chrome). Unfortunately, as of early 2025 there's a plague
of high volume crawlers (apparently in part to gather data for LLM
training) that use a variety of old browser user agents, especially
Chrome user agents. To reduce the load on
Wandering Thoughts
I'm experimenting with
(attempting to) block all of them, and you've run into this.
If this is in error and you're using a current version of your
browser of choice, you can contact me at
my current place at the
university
(you should be able to work out the email address
from that). If possible, please let me know what browser you're
using and so on, ideally with its exact User-Agent string.
A special note for people using archive.*
You may be seeing this through archive.today, archive.ph, archive.is,
and so on. Unfortunately, archive.* crawls pages to archive in a way that
is impossible to distinguish from malicious actors. They use old Chrome
User-Agent values, crawl from IP address blocks that are widely distributed
and not clearly identified as theirs, and some of their IP addresses have
falsified reverse DNS entries that claim they are googlebot IP addresses
(which is something that is normally done only by quite bad actors). I
suggest that you use archive.org, which is a better behaved archival
crawler and can crawl
my blog (Wandering Thoughts)
.
Chris Siebenmann, 2025-02-17

data.title: Historically Accurate Airport Dioramas by AV Pro Designs
data.author: surprisetalk
data.article_summary: 前航空公司飞行员Brian Keene退休后创立了AV Pro Designs公司，专门制作1:1400比例的历史精确机场微缩模型。这些模型基于档案照片和Keene的飞行经验，重现特定年代的著名机场，如70-80年代的JFK机场、80-90年代的LAX机场等。公司已完成肯尼迪、希思罗等机场模型，正在制作香港启德和巴黎戴高乐机场。作品主要销售给博物馆、机构和模型爱好者群体。特别值得一提的是，孟买机场模型采用了夜景设计，效果尤为惊艳。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[不同时代和类型的模型展示及其技术变迁]

不同观点：
• **历史模型的价值与现状**  
  - Wistar提到美国陆军工程兵团的湾区水文模型（Bay Model），强调其规模和历史意义，并指出从过去的冷清到如今的受欢迎程度变化。  
  - 例子：模型大小超过足球场，过去参观人数稀少，现在需排队。

• **现代模型与技术的结合**  
  - michaelbuckbee认为现代技术（如EufyMake打印机或3D打印）可以大幅节省传统手工制作模型的时间。  
  - 论据：引用Adam Savage的评测视频，展示高效纹理打印技术。  
  - 争议点：传统手工工艺与现代自动化技术的优劣对比。

• **特定模型展示的推荐**  
  - mwexler提到肯尼迪机场模型在TWA酒店大堂的展示，推荐其作为旅行中的参观项目。  
  - Animats推荐汉堡的“迷你奇幻世界”（Minatur Wunderland）机场模型，强调其细节丰富。

补充讨论：
• **历史照片与真实色彩的争议**  
  - MarkusQ提出疑问：老式立体模型的泛黄色调是否真实反映了历史场景，还是摄影技术导致的偏差？引发对历史准确性与感知差异的讨论。  
  - 讨论关系：关联到其他用户对模型保存状态的观察（如Wistar提到的模型变迁）。

45996527.article_content:
Historically Accurate Airport Dioramas by AV Pro Designs
A retired airline pilot continues his obsession
By
Rain Noe
-
October 21
in
Object Culture
Brian Keene is a former airline pilot and retired airline industry executive who remains obsessed with airports. So much so that in his retirement, he started
AV Pro Designs
, a company that manufactures dioramas of famous airports. (They sell them to museums, institutions and "the diorama community," whatever that is.)
In designing the 1:1400 models, Keene draws on both his own experiences as a pilot and archival photographs, recreating the airports as they appeared during certain eras. The company's rendition of JFK is from the '70s and '80s, LAX in the '80s and '90s, for instance.
Their model of BOM (Mumbai's airport) is particularly striking, as they've done the nighttime view.
The company's also done Heathrow and Newark; Hong Kong's Kai Tak and France's Charles de Gaulle are in the works.

data.author: raus22
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Raspberry Pi 近期的硬件和软件更新及其对用户体验的影响

不同观点：
• 正面评价：
  - Raspberry Pi 今年在硬件配件和软件方面表现活跃，持续推出新功能（如安全启动配置），且发布时间与用户需求高度契合（sq_）
  - Raspberry Pi 的真正价值在于持续的软件更新和社区支持，即使硬件性价比不高，软件表现依然出色（Mr_Eri_Atlov）
  - Raspberry Pi Imager 工具在创建可启动U盘（如Debian和TrueNAS）方面表现优秀，用户体验良好（nodesocket）
  - 最新版本的安装流程用户体验流畅（risyachka）

• 负面/担忧：
  - 新版本取消了通过 wpa_supplicant.conf 文件预配置Wi-Fi的传统方式，强制使用GUI工具，可能损害高级用户的灵活性（mschuster91）
  - 虽然改进新手友好度值得赞赏，但不应该以牺牲高级用户的功能为代价（mschuster91）

补充讨论：
争议焦点集中在：便捷性改进与高级用户控制权之间的平衡问题。特别是Wi-Fi配置方式的改变引发了关于"新手友好 vs 高级用户控制"的讨论。

不同观点：
• **传统评估方法的回归**  
  - 建议通过口头答辩、面对面讨论（如ecshafer提到的代码演示）来验证学生的真实理解，避免依赖AI检测工具。  
  - 11101010001100认为，简短的口试即可判断学生是否真正掌握知识。  
  - qsort指出，闭卷笔试加口试的传统方式仍然有效，无需因AI改变。  

• **教育模式需根本性改革**  
  - TheAceOfHearts主张减少记忆和测试，转向项目制学习，培养学生的高能动性和工具整合能力。  
  - SunshineTheCat批评当前教育过度依赖记忆和重复，认为AI暴露了这种模式的低效性。  
  - sharkjacobs质疑课堂测试的实用性，认为其与实际工作需求脱节。  

• **AI作为教育工具的合理使用**  
  - solomonb提出通过“刻意抄袭”练习教授引用规范，类似方法可引导学生将AI作为研究工具而非作弊手段。  
  - KerryJones建议设计“会出错的AI工具”，让学生在纠错中学习，而非禁止AI。  
  - cadamsdotcom提出用AI生成个性化试卷，平衡公平性与防作弊。  

补充讨论：  
- **争议焦点**：AI检测工具的可靠性（如开篇案例中“100%误判”）及其对诚实学生的潜在伤害。  
- **教育者的困境**：kingstnap指出，好的教学法（如开放实验、口试）与行政效率需求（如自动评分）存在根本矛盾。  
- **技术中立性**：ekjhgkejhgk强调，关键在于培养学生的批判性思维，而非抵制技术本身。
